title: Di Ling Ai: Shui Xin Chan
description:
After the great war, chaos rose from the abyss, and darkness engulfed the earth like a tidal wave… Dimo ​​and the Water Emperor traveled to Rome to find a way to seal it, but chaos had already dragged the Ice Emperor and Yanhu into the abyss… A mysterious Tarot messenger appeared… The Ship King's backlash grew stronger, and Princess Du framed the Spirit Emperor but accidentally awakened the fairy in the icy cage. The group finally discovered the weakness of chaos… Can they work together to seal chaos? Can love and faith write a new myth?

(Source: iQIYI, translated)
